verification_notes: Audited from first principles: Microscopic conduction model rigorously verified. Drift velocity expression v_d = -(e*tau/m)E = -mu*E derived from Newton's second law and Drude momentum relaxation time hypothesis. Dimensional analysis confirmed: [mu] = m^2/(V*s), [v_d] = m/s, [J] = A/m^2, [sigma] = S/m. Limiting cases verified: E -> 0 yields v_d -> 0 and J -> 0; tau -> 0 yields zero conductivity; n -> 0 recovers ideal dielectric limit. Assumptions audited: Free electron gas in isotropic lattice, randomizing thermal collisions with <v_th> = 0, and classical Drude relaxation time. Claim traces to curriculum node and formula-curr-drift-micro verified.
